open_incidents.summary: Flags postcodes whose Australia-Post-range-heuristic jurisdiction doesn't match their sales_source's expected jurisdiction (e.g. nsw_vg_sales data under a QLD/ACT-range postcode). Advisory, not blocking -- WS8 already investigated and documented this as a real, small-volume, unresolved case; this rule keeps it visible on every run rather than a one-time finding that gets forgotten. (16 affected)

Every registered source URL should still resolve (2xx) and, for sources known to serve a direct data file, not silently redirect to an HTML page (a classic 'source moved, old link now serves a 200 OK landing page' failure). (1 affected)
Each source geography's correspondence weights should sum to ~1.0 (documented ABS special-code exclusions mean this is advisory, not a hard blocker -- see WS4's methodology doc). (6 affected)
